text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby was feeling unwell, so I 
brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Understood. I shall take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Prominent Corporation Chairman
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on winning the 'Umamusume 
Who Looks Best with a Parasol' contest!"

text_block_list.name: Prominent Corporation Chairman
text_block_list.text:
The glory of reaching the top of the 
world! Your parents and your entire clan 
must be overjoyed!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...... ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Milady. It is nearly time for your victory 
speech.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
And now, a speech from our winner! Please, 
come up to the stage with your parasol!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I take immense pride in having won such a 
prestigious contest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Businessperson A
text_block_list.text:
Splendid indeed! Such a dignified 
presence! Her refined posture makes the 
parasol stand out even more...!

text_block_list.name: Businessperson B
text_block_list.text:
Her expression remains unbroken even under 
the shower of applause—magnificent! She 
stands out so brilliantly in the shade 
cast by her parasol!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...So it was a dream.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
............ World-famous with a 
parasol...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What a bizarre award to be bestowed with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby murmured, the corners of her 
mouth seeming to soften slightly. Perhaps 
due to a pleasant dream, she had fully 
regained her stride.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. It appears I have 
forgotten my umbrella...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What an unpleasant way to wake up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether due to a bad dream or not, Daiichi 
Ruby was unable to return to her usual 
form.
